name: Fortune Cookie Select
original_name: フォーチュンクッキーセレクト
source:
The Takaya family is as unlucky as ever, but life continues and its members support each other and have fun together.
Game includes after-stories of each heroine.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高屋一家依然霉运不断，但生活仍在继续，家人们也始终互相扶持、共同享受每一天。
游戏收录了各位女主角的后日谈。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
